kavora.effect.lava.warmth.tip: Shifts the material's emitted light toward cooler or warmer tones. Zero leaves its warmth unchanged.
kavora.effect.lava.hue.tip: Rotates the hue of the material's emitted light. The value is an offset in degrees.
kavora.effect.lava.saturation.tip: Scales the color of the material's emitted light. Zero is grayscale and one preserves the saturation.
kavora.effect.lava.intensity.tip: Scales emitted brightness, including light cast onto nearby blocks. One preserves the material's brightness.
kavora.effect.fog.lowerHeightFalloff.tip: Blocks below the base for fog density to fall to 1/e. Zero keeps the density constant below the base.
kavora.effect.mist.density.tip: Extinction per block for persistent ground mist. Zero lets weather and biome profiles set its density.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseOctaves.tip: Number of detail layers in the fog density field. Higher values cost more to sample.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseLacunarity.tip: Frequency multiplier between successive fog noise layers.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseGain.tip: Amplitude multiplier between successive fog noise layers.
kavora.effect.fog.depthDistribution.tip: Higher values place more fog depth slices near the camera.
kavora.effect.nrc.trainingIterations.tip: Target NRC training iterations per frame. More iterations respond faster to lighting changes and increase GPU work.
kavora.effect.nrc.trainingFeedback.tip: Contribution of cached indirect lighting during NRC self-training.
kavora.effect.nrc.featureSize.tip: Smallest feature size the neural radiance cache attempts to resolve, in blocks.
kavora.effect.nrc.terminationThreshold.t: Threshold used to decide when a path can query the neural cache.
kavora.effect.bloom.radius.tip: Number of blur scales. Higher values spread bloom farther from bright pixels.
kavora.effect.lens.enabled.tip: Enable motion blur, chromatic aberration, and vignette.
kavora.effect.lens.chromaticAberration.t: Separate color channels near the edges of the image.
kavora.effect.lens.chromaticAmount.tip: How far apart the color channels are sampled.
kavora.effect.lens.chromaticFalloff.tip: How strongly the effect is reduced near the center.
kavora.effect.lens.vignette.tip: Darken the outer portion of the image.
kavora.effect.lens.vignetteIntensity.tip: How strongly the vignette darkens the image.
kavora.effect.lens.vignetteRadius.tip: Distance from the center at which the vignette begins.
kavora.effect.lens.vignetteSoftness.tip: Width of the transition into the vignette.
kavora.effect.lens.motionBlur.tip: Blend pixels along their motion in the scene.
kavora.effect.lens.shutter.tip: Fraction of the frame interval used as simulated exposure time.
kavora.effect.lens.blurRadius.tip: Maximum blur footprint as a fraction of the image size.
kavora.effect.lens.blurSamples.tip: Number of samples along a motion vector.
kavora.effect.image.inversionAmount.tip: Mix the final image with its inverted colors. Zero disables inversion.
kavora.effect.image.inversionMode.tip: Choose a full negative or invert darker pixels and map brighter pixels to black.
kavora.effect.image.inversionThreshold.t: Brightness cutoff used by threshold inversion.
kavora.effect.fog.ambientRadiance.red.ti: Scene-linear ambient light available to scatter through the fog.
Scene-linear ambient light available to scatter through the fog.
kavora.effect.fog.ambientRadiance.blue.t: Scene-linear ambient light available to scatter through the fog.
kavora.settings.preview.tip: Hide the panel to inspect the applied effects. Apply pending changes first.
kavora.settings.resetPending.tip: Stage defaults for this folder. At the root, reset all visual settings. Apply to commit; Cancel to discard.
kavora.settings.editHint: Drag to adjust. Right-click or Ctrl-click for exact input. Shift-click to restore the default. Apply commits all folders together.
kavora.settings.choiceEditHint: Left-click for the next choice, right-click for the previous choice. Shift-click to restore the default. Apply commits all folders together.
kavora.settings.toggleEditHint: Click to toggle. Shift-click to restore the default. Apply commits all folders together.
kavora.setting.fog.automatic.tip: Patchy ground mist appears near dawn and during wet weather in humid biomes.
kavora.setting.fog.automaticStrength.tip: Scales automatic condensation density. Map biome and zone profiles can override its appearance.
kavora.effect.mist.baseHeight.tip: World height below which ground mist reaches full density.
kavora.effect.mist.heightFalloff.tip: Height in blocks for ground-mist density to fall by a factor of e above its base.
kavora.effect.mist.regionSize.tip: Horizontal size of the world-space mist patches, in blocks.
kavora.effect.fog.baseHeight.tip: World height at which the authored fog reaches full density. Ground mist has its own height controls.
kavora.effect.fog.heightFalloff.tip: Height in blocks for density to fall by a factor of e above its base. Zero keeps density constant above the base.
kavora.effect.water.ior.tip: Index of refraction. Typical clear water is about 1.33.
kavora.effect.water.absorptionDistance.t: Distance in blocks used to measure the water transmittance color.
kavora.effect.water.red.tip: Red-channel light transmission at the water optical distance.
kavora.effect.water.green.tip: Green-channel light transmission at the water optical distance.
kavora.effect.water.blue.tip: Blue-channel light transmission at the water optical distance.
kavora.effect.water.animationFps.tip: Water normal-animation frames per second. Zero holds the first frame.
Fraction of light that travels the medium distance while the camera is submerged.
kavora.effect.water.cameraAbsorptionDist: Distance in blocks used to measure light transmission in the submerged camera's water medium. Fog has its own distance.
kavora.effect.fog.transmittance.red.tip: Light transmission color at the fog optical distance, in sRGB.
kavora.effect.fog.transmittance.green.ti: Light transmission color at the fog optical distance, in sRGB.
kavora.effect.fog.transmittance.blue.tip: Light transmission color at the fog optical distance, in sRGB.
kavora.effect.fog.scatteringAlbedo.red.t: Fraction of extinguished light scattered rather than absorbed; linear RGB.
kavora.effect.fog.scatteringAlbedo.green: Fraction of extinguished light scattered rather than absorbed; linear RGB.
Fraction of extinguished light scattered rather than absorbed; linear RGB.
kavora.effect.image.colorBalance.red.tip: Color-channel gain with color grading enabled, in either tone-mapping mode.
kavora.effect.image.colorBalance.green.t: Color-channel gain with color grading enabled, in either tone-mapping mode.
kavora.effect.image.colorBalance.blue.ti: Color-channel gain with color grading enabled, in either tone-mapping mode.
kavora.effect.clouds.windSpeed.tip: Multiplier on wind-driven cloud movement. Zero freezes advection.
kavora.effect.clouds.anisotropy.tip: Controls the directionality of light scattering by cloud droplets.
Strength of the approximate diffuse light transport inside dense clouds.
kavora.effect.clouds.coverage.tip: Fraction of the cloud density field filled with clouds; rain adds coverage.
kavora.effect.clouds.thickness.tip: Maximum cumulus thickness in blocks. Fair-weather clouds are shallower; thunderstorms grow toward this limit.
kavora.effect.clouds.altitudeOffset.tip: Additional height above the world's cloud level, in blocks. The general Clouds Height control also applies.
kavora.effect.clouds.shapeScale.tip: Horizontal size of cloud formations in blocks.
kavora.effect.clouds.density.tip: Extinction per block. Higher density increases opacity and self-shadowing.
kavora.effect.clouds.distance.tip: Cloud ray integration distance in blocks, independent of terrain render distance.
kavora.effect.clouds.samples.tip: Higher values resolve finer density detail. Longer distances and finer sampling increase GPU cost.
kavora.effect.clouds.shadowSamples.tip: Samples used for sunlight and moonlight attenuation within clouds.
kavora.effect.fog.range.tip: Distance in blocks at which the configured fog transmittance is measured.
kavora.effect.fog.anisotropy.tip: Negative values scatter backward; zero scatters evenly; positive values favor forward shafts.
kavora.effect.fog.translucentShadows.tip: Allows water and colored glass to attenuate light entering the fog.
kavora.effect.fog.noise.tip: Adds world-space variation to volumetric fog density.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseSpeed.tip: Speed of the density field when density variation is enabled.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseScale.tip: Density scale for the heterogeneous fog field.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseExponent.tip: Higher values separate clear gaps from dense fog banks.
kavora.effect.fog.noiseFrequency.tip: Spatial frequency of the fog density field, per block.
kavora.effect.lighting.direct.tip: Enables direct lighting from the sun, moon and local emitters.
kavora.effect.lighting.secondary.tip: Enables secondary light transport, including bounced illumination.
kavora.effect.shadows.coloredDirect.tip: Evaluates colored transparent occluders for direct lighting.
kavora.effect.shadows.coloredIndirect.ti: Evaluates colored transparent occluders along secondary-light paths.
kavora.effect.reflection.psrr.tip: Separately resolves smooth reflection chains for stable water and mirrors. When disabled, reflections use the general path-tracing integrator.
kavora.effect.reflection.pstr.tip: Separately resolves refraction through water and glass. When disabled, transmission uses the general path-tracing integrator.
kavora.effect.materials.normalStrength.t: Strength of normal maps on opaque PBR materials.
kavora.effect.materials.translucentNorma: Normal map strength for transparent surfaces such as water and glass.
kavora.effect.water.simulation.tip: Simulate nearby splashes and blend the resulting slopes into the water surface.
kavora.effect.water.rippleStrength.tip: Scale the height and steepness of waves from nearby splashes. Zero disables these waves.
kavora.effect.water.windWaves.tip: Add long wind waves and shorter ripples to horizontal water surfaces.
kavora.effect.water.windStrength.tip: Scale the height and steepness of wind waves. Zero disables wind waves.
kavora.effect.water.dropletRings.tip: Draw expanding rings from rain and spray near strong splashes.
kavora.effect.water.ringStrength.tip: Scale the steepness of rain and spray rings. Zero disables the rings.
kavora.effect.water.floatingSludge.tip: Allow disturbances to open temporary holes in surfaces marked as floating sludge.
kavora.effect.particles.spawnBySurfaceAr: Distributes births evenly over the surface of emitters using the Remix global preset.
kavora.effect.particles.minScreenSize.ti: Minimum particle edge in internal render pixels for Remix emitters. Set to 0 to disable the minimum.
kavora.effect.particles.maxScreenSize.ti: Maximum particle edge in internal render pixels for Remix emitters. Set to 0 to disable the maximum.
kavora.effect.particles.screenSizeCovera: Reduces opacity as particles are enlarged to their minimum size. A value of 1 preserves apparent coverage.
kavora.effect.sss.inRefraction.tip: Keeps thin-surface light transmission on refracted leaf and plant surfaces.
kavora.effect.sss.transmission.tip: Enables light transmission within materials carrying subsurface data.
kavora.effect.sss.singleScattering.tip: Adds the single-scattering component of subsurface transmission.
kavora.effect.sss.diffusionScale.tip: Scales diffusion-profile radii on materials using diffusion profiles.
kavora.effect.bloom.strength.tip: Intensity of halos around bright regions.
kavora.effect.bloom.threshold.tip: Suppresses bloom from dim regions below this luminance.
kavora.effect.image.tonemapper.tip: 0: Global. 1: Local. The matching controls below only affect their selected mode.
kavora.effect.image.localContrast.tip: Enhances local contrast when Local tone mapping is selected.
kavora.effect.image.localAces.tip: Applies the ACES finishing curve after Local tone mapping.
kavora.effect.image.globalExposure.tip: Exposure compensation for Global tone mapping.
kavora.effect.image.grading.tip: Enables color balance and contrast after either Local or Global tone mapping.
kavora.effect.image.contrast.tip: Image contrast with color grading enabled, in either tone-mapping mode.
kavora.effect.exposure.enabled.tip: Adapts exposure when moving between dark and bright environments.
kavora.effect.exposure.speed.tip: Higher values adapt more quickly to changes in scene brightness.
kavora.effect.exposure.center.tip: Gives the center of the image more influence on exposure.
kavora.effect.exposure.centerSize.tip: Size of the emphasized region when center metering is enabled.
kavora.effect.exposure.average.tip: 0: Mean. 1: Median; more stable around extreme brightness.
kavora.video.frameGeneration.tip: Generates intermediate frames without lowering rendering quality. Available multipliers depend on the GPU and driver. Paused screens use rendered frames only.
kavora.preparingRenderingTimedOut: RTX rendering did not become ready within two minutes. Check the renderer log before trying again.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.saturatio: Sets the color saturation of this beacon's lens and beam from grayscale to twice the dye's saturation.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.intensity: Sets this placed beacon's beam and glowing lens brightness. Off disables both.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.cone.tip: Sets the beam half-angle. 90 degrees illuminates a full forward hemisphere.
When enabled, the beam and head animation run only while the beacon receives redstone power.
Sets the axis's neutral angle. Animated bounds are offsets around this position.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.rotationS: Sets signed continuous rotation speed in degrees per second.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.minimum.t: Sets the minimum animated offset from the neutral position.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.maximum.t: Sets the maximum animated offset from the neutral position.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.cycle.tip: Sets the duration of one complete smooth oscillation.
container.kavora.copper_beacon.patrol.ti: Sets the time between deterministic smooth patrol targets.
kavora.settings.title: Kavora Shader Settings
kavora.settings.reset.tip: Restore the settings on this page to their default values.
kavora.settings.reset.confirm.title: Reset %s Settings?
kavora.settings.reset.confirm.message: This resets every setting in %s. Continue?
kavora.settings.resetAll.tip: Restore all visual effects to their defaults. Performance settings remain in Sodium.
kavora.settings.resetAll.confirm.title: Reset All Visual Effects?
kavora.settings.resetAll.confirm.message: This resets lighting, sky, weather, materials and post-processing. Continue?
kavora.setting.fog.enabled.tip: Light scattering and absorption in the atmosphere, including local lights and shafts.
kavora.settings.blockLights.title: Block Lights
kavora.setting.dist.autoFade.tip: Match the Remix terrain fade band to Minecraft's render distance without overriding stronger situational profiles.
kavora.setting.dist.light.tip: Chunks beyond which block lights are culled. Auto follows Minecraft's render distance.
kavora.setting.dist.entity.tip: Chunks beyond which entities are not submitted. Auto uses Minecraft's view distance.
kavora.setting.light.reach.tip: Blocks from the camera at which a torch stops casting light. Brighter lights reach further and dimmer ones less. Lower values shrink the light list the path tracer samples from.
kavora.setting.framerate.unfocused.tip: Framerate cap while the game window is not focused. Lower values leave the GPU to other applications. Unlimited leaves only Minecraft's Max Framerate in force.
kavora.setting.sky.ambient.tip: Toggle the ambient area light derived from the sky.
kavora.setting.sky.haloFocus.tip: Controls how tightly atmospheric haze gathers around the sun and moon. Higher values create smaller, brighter halos; lower values spread a softer glow across more of the sky.
kavora.setting.clouds.procedural.tip: Choose Volumetric for three-dimensional participating clouds or Classic for Minecraft's blocky cloud style.
kavora.setting.clouds.vanillaEdgeSmoothn: Softens the edges of Minecraft's classic blocky clouds. Set this to zero for sharp, square edges.
kavora.setting.clouds.size.tip: Changes the thickness of Classic clouds. Volumetric cloud thickness and shape scale have separate controls.
kavora.setting.clouds.height.tip: Moves clouds higher or lower in the sky.
kavora.setting.sky.sunIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of direct sunlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
kavora.setting.sky.moonPhaseContrast.tip: Strength of moon phases in lunar illumination. Zero keeps constant moonlight; one makes a new moon unlit. Full-moon brightness stays unchanged.
kavora.setting.sky.moonSize.tip: Apparent size of the lunar surface. Independent of atmospheric glow, moonlight intensity and shadow softness.
kavora.setting.sky.moonIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of moonlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
kavora.setting.sky.dayAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the daytime sky.
kavora.setting.sky.nightAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the night sky.
kavora.setting.blockLights.multiplier.ti: Multiplies this block light's normal brightness. Off disables it; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. Changes apply when you leave this screen and rebuild loaded terrain once.
kavora.setting.materials.terrainEmission: Multiplies the light emitted by glowing block surfaces. Off disables their glow; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. This does not change block lights such as torches.
kavora.setting.materials.smoothReliefMap: Samples normal and height maps smoothly, which removes banding from surface bumps and depth, while block textures keep their pixelated look.
kavora.setting.post.exposure.tip: Makes the whole scene brighter or darker. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
kavora.setting.post.shadows.tip: Controls how bright shaded areas appear. Raise it to reveal more detail in shadows. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
kavora.setting.post.highlights.tip: Controls sunlight, emissive blocks, and other very bright areas. Raise it to darken intense highlights and preserve more detail. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
kavora.setting.post.lowLightAdaptation.t: Helps you see in dark places. Lower values reveal more detail, but can make illuminated areas look pale or washed out. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
Helps your view adjust to very bright scenes so sunlight and emissive blocks remain comfortable and readable. Higher values tame harsh brightness, but can make daylight look dimmer. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
kavora.video.title: Path Tracing
kavora.video.enabled.tip: Render the world with Kavora path tracing. Apply once to rebuild terrain when switching.
kavora.video.dlss.tip: DLAA uses native resolution. Other modes use DLSS Super Resolution, independently of the visual quality profile.
kavora.video.reconstruction.tip: Use DLSS Ray Reconstruction for path-traced lighting and material detail, independently of the visual quality profile.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.title: DLSS 5
kavora.video.neuralRendering.enabled.tip: Use DLSS 5 to adjust scene detail, lighting and color. This increases GPU work and memory use.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.initializin: DLSS is initializing. Reopen video settings to refresh availability.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.unavailable: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering is unavailable with the current GPU, driver or runtime.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.settings.ti: Choose a model and tune the effect.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.model.tip: Choose among three models. Compare their appearance in the current scene.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.intensity.t: Controls how strongly neural rendering affects the image.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.structuralS: Controls adjustments to details, shadows and materials.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.toneStrengt: Controls adjustments to brightness and color.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.useAutoMask: Combines the model's character mask with the material control mask.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.skinStructu: Controls character detail adjustments when the automatic mask is enabled.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.enableHighl: Recovers bright highlights from the original HDR image.
kavora.video.neuralRendering.enableVolum: Accounts for fog and translucent surfaces when weighting the effect.
kavora.video.blockLights.tip: Adjust light intensity for individual blocks.
kavora.effect.lighting.indirect.tip: Select the indirect-lighting algorithm. NRC is the default and requires a supported NVIDIA GPU.
kavora.effect.lighting.bounces.tip: More bounces preserve more indirect-light transport at a higher GPU cost. Native supported range: 0–15.
kavora.effect.lighting.rtxdi.tip: Reservoir sampling improves direct lighting with many lights. Disabling it uses the runtime’s simpler light sampler.
kavora.effect.lighting.sparse.tip: Trace fewer pixels and reconstruct them with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. Requires DLSS and Ray Reconstruction; otherwise the runtime suspends sparse rendering.
kavora.effect.cache.combine.tip: Combine update and query tracing to reduce dispatch overhead. Lighting queries read the previous frame’s resolved cache.
kavora.effect.cache.primary.tip: Use the radiance cache for leaves and other thin opaque surfaces. Disabling it increases tracing work and can change noise.
kavora.effect.cache.filter.tip: Filter cached lighting using compatible surface normals. Material textures are not blurred.
kavora.effect.cache.spatialJitter.tip: Jitter thin-surface cache queries to reduce visible voxel boundaries.
kavora.effect.cache.lodJitter.tip: Stochastically blend adjacent cache levels to soften level transitions.
kavora.effect.fog.grid.tip: Render pixels per lighting cell. Smaller spacing resolves finer light shafts, using more GPU time and video memory. Does not change surface textures.
kavora.effect.fog.depthSlices.tip: Depth samples in the ray-traced lighting volume. More layers resolve finer shadow boundaries and use proportionally more GPU time and video memory.
kavora.effect.fog.history.tip: Maximum accumulated lighting frames. Longer history reduces noise but responds more slowly to moving lights and shadows.
kavora.effect.clouds.transport.tip: World volume preserves local cloud occlusion and parallax. Sky map shares a camera-centered cloud layer between background rays; flying inside clouds is approximate.
kavora.effect.clouds.skyResolution.tip: Height in pixels of the shared 2:1 cloud sky map. Higher values preserve finer cloud edges and reflections. Only used by Sky map.
kavora.effect.lighting.minBounces.tip: Minimum indirect path length before Russian roulette may terminate a path.
kavora.effect.lighting.samplingQuality.t: Adaptive sparse-rendering quality. Higher values trace more pixels; this does not change output resolution.
Distribute indirect shading work using the estimated local lighting error.
kavora.effect.lighting.samplingRate.tip: Fraction of pixels shaded when adaptive sparse sampling is disabled.
Controls how sparse sampling density scales with render resolution.
kavora.effect.lighting.sparseTransparenc: Limit transparent-surface search using the sparse shading mask.
kavora.effect.cache.records.tip: Target number of radiance-cache updates per frame. Zero uses the full update resolution. Smaller budgets reduce work but can converge more slowly.
kavora.effect.materials.pom.tip: Choose quadtree occlusion, ray-marched occlusion, or a two-height-sample offset approximation. Offset parallax retains depth motion and normal-mapped shading, with less accurate overlap and grazing-angle relief.
kavora.effect.materials.pomIterations.ti: Heightfield search and relief-shadow sampling budget. Offset parallax uses two height samples for the view offset; this budget still controls its relief shadows.
kavora.effect.materials.pomDirect.tip: Evaluate height-map occlusion for direct lighting.
kavora.effect.materials.pomIndirect.tip: Evaluate height-map occlusion for indirect lighting.
kavora.effect.materials.pomNee.tip: Evaluate height-map occlusion in the next-event lighting cache.
kavora.effect.materials.pomRestir.tip: Preserve height-map effects when reusing indirect-light samples.
kavora.effect.materials.pomIndirectHit.t: Evaluate relief at indirect ray hits, in addition to the camera surface.
kavora.effect.materials.pomPsr.tip: Evaluate relief along reflection and refraction continuation paths.
kavora.effect.materials.pomTransmissionS: Correct deep relief edges seen through water and thick glass. Applies to Raymarch and Quadtree POM. Can cost GPU time in scenes with refracted relief.
kavora.quality.title: Quality profiles
kavora.quality.tip: Set the preset's sampling and rendering budgets. Only edits to preset-controlled values mark a tier as Custom.
kavora.quality.ultra.tip: Full world-space clouds and fog lighting integration, quadtree relief and the largest sampling budgets. DLSS and frame generation remain independent.
kavora.quality.high.tip: Shared high-resolution clouds, depth-resolved fog volume, quadtree relief and two indirect bounces.
kavora.quality.medium.tip: Retains ray-traced lighting and water. Uses shared clouds, a coarser fog volume, ray-marched relief and moderate lighting budgets.
kavora.quality.low.tip: Retains ray-traced lighting, water and reflections. Uses shared clouds, a coarser fog volume and two-sample offset parallax, with smaller lighting budgets.
kavora.effect.nightSky.enabled.tip: Stars, the Milky Way and meteors share the sky used by reflections and lighting. Clouds and weather obscure them.
kavora.effect.nightSky.starIntensity.tip: Brightness of the fixed star field. Daylight fades it out automatically.
kavora.effect.nightSky.milkyWayIntensity: Brightness of the galactic band and its dust lanes. Zero hides the band without hiding individual stars.
kavora.effect.nightSky.meteorRate.tip: Average meteor events per world minute. Their motion follows world time; zero disables them.
kavora.effect.nightSky.meteorIntensity.t: Brightness of meteor heads and fading trails. Reflections see the same event as the sky.
kavora.effect.endSky.enabled.tip: Ringed planet, accretion flow, nebula and stars, adapted from Caustica-Horizon into the shared path-traced environment.
kavora.effect.endSky.intensity.tip: Scale the complete End environment radiance. Camera, reflections, refraction and lighting use the same environment.
kavora.effect.endSky.backgroundIntensity: Brightness of the stellar and nebular background behind the planet and accretion flow.
kavora.effect.endSky.haloIntensity.tip: Brightness of the broad halo around the accretion flow.
kavora.effect.endSky.animationSpeed.tip: World-synchronized orbital and accretion animation speed. Zero freezes the environment.
kavora.effect.endSky.rotation.tip: Rotate the complete environment horizontally in degrees.
kavora.effect.endSky.elevation.tip: Tilt the complete cosmic environment in degrees. The sphere has no ground plane or horizon clipping.
kavora.effect.fog.integration.tip: Lighting-grid integration resolves each ray segment in world space. View-volume integration stores depth-resolved scattering and attenuation for reuse between nearby camera rays. Reflections and refractions retain world-space integration.
Width of a view-volume column in pixels. Smaller values preserve narrower light shafts; larger values share more work. Depth resolution follows the fog depth slices.
kavora.effect.fog.initialSamples.tip: Candidates considered for each volume lighting sample. Lower values reduce sampling work while retaining scattering and ray-traced visibility.
kavora.effect.fog.spatialSamples.tip: Nearby lighting samples reused by the volume reservoir. Fewer samples reduce work but can increase light-beam noise.
kavora.effect.lighting.initialSamples.ti: Light candidates considered by RTXDI. Lower values preserve direct illumination and shadows with less work and more sampling noise.
kavora.effect.lighting.spatialSamples.ti: Nearby RTXDI samples reused on stable surfaces. More samples improve stability at additional cost.
kavora.effect.lighting.disocclusionSampl: RTXDI spatial samples used on newly visible surfaces. More samples reduce noise during movement.
kavora.setting.materials.autoPbr.tip: Fill missing normal and material maps on static terrain textures using their color detail and material type. Authored PBR channels take priority. Apply rebuilds loaded terrain once.
kavora.effect.lighting.risSamples.tip: Light candidates considered on indirect rays, and on direct rays when RTXDI is disabled. Smaller budgets preserve illumination with less work and more sampling noise.
kavora.effect.fog.lightingGrid.tip: Downsample the fog grid for light selection. Larger values reuse more lighting samples spatially, with less precise small shadows. Scattering and ray-traced visibility remain active.
kavora.effect.fog.lightingDepthSlices.ti: Depth resolution of the volume light sampler. More slices resolve smaller changes along light shafts and use more work and memory.
kavora.effect.sss.transmissionSamples.ti: Transmission directions sampled through subsurface materials. More samples reduce noise at additional ray-tracing cost.
kavora.effect.sss.scatteringSamples.tip: Single-scattering samples along each subsurface transmission ray. Higher values reduce sampling noise without changing the authored material.
